literature_notes: The sole ledger line (L1) reports a V5-His6 tag fused to the C-terminus of full-length human P2RY11. The C-terminus (residue 374) lies within IC4 (residues 326–374), which is intracellular per the authoritative topology landmarks. A C-terminal tag on an intracellular tail does not place any sequence on the extracellular face and therefore does not qualify as a surface tag site. No ledger line reports any tag insertion at the extracellular N-terminus (EC1, residues 1–29), in any of the four extracellular loops (EC2 88–103, EC3 167–201, EC4 271–297), or at any other extracellular position. Zero sites is the correct answer.

literature_other_positions.note: V5-His6 tag placed at the C-terminus of full-length P2RY11; residue 374 (Q) falls in IC4 (326–374), the intracellular C-terminal tail — not accessible from the extracellular face.
